semantic_changes: Generic encoded PE representations are notable file properties, not operation or family attribution.

Bare RunOnce suffixes and the Go Run prefix were consolidated into the canonical registry-path matcher; its source scope now includes C/C++/C#/Go. Duplicate count legs were removed without lowering needs.
LSASS spelling uses word boundaries and includes the migrated Windows script scopes.
ShadowCopy was tightened to the actual managed ShadowCopyFiles property name; volume shadow-copy code is not managed app shadow deployment.
OpenSSH context requires a version banner, package name, install path, or upstream banner; OpenSSH private-key handling alone is not OpenSSH application identity.
The bare Invoke string was replaced by a reflected invocation capability in the split method dispatcher; impossible batch/shell types were removed from its dependent composite.
PoisonIvy shellcode wrapper attribution now additionally requires its kernes32 payload marker.
The generic SNOWGLAZE union and hostile identity alias were retired; the existing suspicious SOCKS-over-WebSocket observation remains.
Generic section entropy, GDI API co-occurrence, event-log APIs, and unsigned filename mismatch do not establish encryption, spying, indicator removal, or loader intent.
